title: Can this genome region be trusted?
points: A gene looks broken.
Is it biology, or a problem in the data?
Investigate before planning the next experiment.
speech: A gene looks broken. Is that a real biological difference, or a problem in the data? GeneTrace investigates genome reliability before researchers plan their next experiment.

title: A missing label does not prove gene loss.
points: Reads: pieces of DNA sequence
Assembly: reconstruction of a genome (the organism's DNA)
Annotation: labels for genes (regions carrying biological instructions)
speech: Sequencing reads DNA pieces. Assembly reconstructs the genome. Annotation labels the genes. Like a book, missing a chapter label does not prove the text is gone.

title: Meta plans. GeneTrace executes and checks.
points: Meta receives the question and available evidence.
Code defines required checks and allowed choices.
Meta selects a check; code executes it.
New results return to Meta for a cited interpretation.
speech: Meta's Muse Spark one point three receives the question and evidence. Code defines required checks and allowed choices. Meta selects a check, code executes it, and new results return for interpretation.

title: Public data, with a clearly defined scope.
points: 100 complete NCBI RefSeq genomes: comparison context
JEONG-1266 · GCF_001558995.2: the demonstration case
756 selected Illumina read pairs · SRR2762258
Regional reanalysis, not whole-run quality control
speech: We use one hundred complete E. coli genomes for comparison context. This demonstration reanalyzes seven hundred fifty six selected public read pairs from one strain. It is not whole run quality control.

title: Why these three genes?
tag: BIOLOGICAL CONTEXT · NOT A FUNCTIONAL ASSAY
speech: Nim T is associated with transport of an antibacterial compound. Nim R regulates gene activity. Yea O's function remains unclear. A false broken gene label could misdirect biological research. Here, the neighbors are nearby comparison sites, not assumed error free controls.

title: The candidate check really executes.
speech: Nim T is labeled as disrupted. GeneTrace runs a fresh read alignment and measures disagreement with the genome. About three percent of compared bases differ. That observation needs context.

title: Meta requests the neighboring check.
speech: Meta requests nearby genes to test whether the discrepancy is confined to the candidate. The selected check actually runs, and the new evidence updates the assessment.

title: Neighbors disagree too. The cause stays open.
note: A local-only cause is not established
speech: Nim R and Yea O also show about two percent disagreement. These data cannot isolate a Nim T specific assembly error. Biological variation, technical effects, or mismatched datasets remain possible.

title: This example demonstrates the working loop.
tag: PROTOTYPE BEHAVIOR · NOT AN ACCURACY BENCHMARK
note: Sources and next verification remain visible
speech: This example demonstrates model choice, real analysis, and reassessment. A fixed policy produced the same measurements; Meta adds selection reasons and cited interpretation. Exact read to assembly version linkage remains unverified.

title: Next: follow up BUSCO completeness flags.
points: BUSCO: conserved genes usually present once in related species
Investigate apparently missing or fragmented markers
Connect genome, gene labels and read evidence
A missing marker is a question, not proof of sequencing error
speech: Next, BUSCO could prioritize apparently missing or fragmented conserved genes for this investigation. These markers are usually present once in related species; they are not all essential genes. This extension is planned, not implemented.

title: Evidence before interpretation.
points: Bring biological context and computational checks together.
Show what was found, what remains uncertain, and what to verify.
github.com/hope9901/GeneTrace_meta
speech: GeneTrace connects biological context, real analysis, and Meta guided interpretation, helping researchers decide what to trust and what to verify next.
